svg.title: TI-B1
svg.text: Stratigraphy from boring log; SPT increments reported in blows per 6 in.
Brown, dry, poorly graded SAND with gravel (fill)
Gray, loose to medium dense, saturated, poorly graded SAND with silt;
occasional shell fragments; loose zone 9 to 12 ft
Gray, soft, saturated, sandy lean CLAY lens with organics and wood fragments;
Gray-green, medium dense, saturated, silty SAND
Dark greenish gray, soft to medium stiff, wet, fat CLAY (Young Bay Mud)
SP-SM – Poorly graded sand with silt
